title: Indoor Robot Vacuum Cleaner Capstone Defense

slides.title: Commercial Benchmark & Target Specifications
bullets: Eufy RoboVac 11S MAX, Xiaomi E10, and Electrolux Trilobite evaluated for drive layout and cleaning mechanics.
Compact circular profile D = 320 mm, total height H = 82 mm (navigates under 110 mm furniture clearance).
Robot mass 4.0 kg, dustbin capacity 0.2 L, continuous battery operating runtime >= 75 minutes.
Main cleaning head coverage >= 70% reachable floor area under open workspace per IEC/ASTM 62885-7:2020.
slides.caption: Figure 1.2: Principle of floor coverage measurement based on grid cell occupancy

slides.title: Locomotion & Drive Layout Selection (2.1.1)
bullets: High agility in confined indoor environments with zero turning radius (in-place spinning R = 0).
Two coaxial driving wheels + one front passive caster wheel (Figure 1.4b).
Simple 3-wheel differential structure, easy assembly/maintenance, stable straight-line travel.
Two driving wheels + 5 passive rollers (Fig 1.6b); rejected due to high rolling resistance and debris jamming.
slides.cap1: Figure 1.4b: Structure 1 — 2 Driving Wheels + 1 Front Caster (Selected)
slides.cap2: Figure 1.6b: Structure 2 — 2 Driving Wheels + 5 Support Rollers (Rejected)

slides.title: Cleaning Mechanism Design Selection (2.1.2)
bullets: Effective floor particulate pickup with moderate power and minimal maintenance.
Direct suction without main brush (Figure 1.8a); purely airflow-dependent, low pickup on smooth floors.
Single roller brush mechanism (Figure 1.8b); rotating chevron brush lifts debris into suction inlet.
Dual 180 RPM side brushes sweep edges into intake; streamlined duct connects to 0.2 L dustbin.
slides.caption: Figure 1.8: Overview of cleaning mechanisms: (a) Direct Suction vs (b) Single Roller (Selected)

slides.title: Wheel Dynamics & Synchronous Belt Transmission
bullets: Normal load N = 19.6 N, tractive force Ft = 1.8 N, traction friction margin Fr = 2.16 N.
Required continuous wheel torque Twheel = 0.081 N.m at rated wheel speed of 88 RPM.
Synchronous timing belt drive (2GT profile, 2.0 mm pitch) with reduction ratio i = 1.5.
Maximum bending stress sigma_max = 18.4 MPa << [sigma] = 85 MPa (Safety factor S > 4.6).
slides.cap1: Figure 3.1: Driving wheel tractive effort and normal force equilibrium
slides.cap2: Figure 3.8: Cantilever brush shaft free-body diagram and stress analysis

slides.title: Chassis Structural FEA & 3D Assembly Design
bullets: Injection-molded ABS shell with internal ribs, deflection < 0.12 mm under 10 kg static payload.
Independent drive wheel suspension modules, cantilever brush assembly, quick-release dustbin.
Convergent suction nozzle coupled to high-speed centrifugal impeller for maximum vacuum pressure.
Comprehensive SolidWorks assembly verifying zero interference and tight manufacturing tolerances.
slides.cap1: Figure 3.15: 3D perspective upper view of complete robot vacuum assembly
slides.cap2: Figure 3.16: 3D underside view showing dual side brushes and roller intake

slides.title: Perception Sensors & Dual-MCU Architecture
bullets: ESP32 Master (Wi-Fi, high-level FSM navigation) + STM32F103 Slave (50 Hz real-time PID loops).
3x front contact microswitches, 3x bottom cliff IR sensors, 1x 6-DOF IMU (yaw feedback).
4S Li-ion battery (14.8V nominal), high-efficiency buck regulators for 5V/3A and 3.3V/1A rails.
Isolated motor power rail prevents inductive voltage dips from affecting MCU digital logic.
slides.caption: Figure 2.1: Electrical block diagram and power distribution architecture

slides.title: Custom 2-Layer PCB Layout & Hardware Realization
bullets: 2-layer FR-4 board, 1.6 mm thickness, dual ground planes for high-frequency noise immunity.
Dual TB6612FNG H-bridge drivers with reverse voltage & thermal shutdown protection.
Low-pass RC filtering on sensor lines and optical isolation on encoder feedback lines.
SMT and through-hole assembly, compact circular profile cleanly fitting chassis interior.
slides.cap1: Figure 4.6: Altium Designer Top & Bottom copper layer routing
slides.cap2: Figure 7.3: Real fabricated 2-layer PCB module installed in chassis

slides.title: Differential Drive Kinematics & IRC Motion Model
bullets: Unicycle model with Instantaneous Rotation Center (IRC) along coaxial wheel drive axis.
Linear speed v = r(w_R + w_L)/2;  Angular speed w = r(w_R - w_L)/b.
Right wheel w_R = (2v + bw)/(2r);  Left wheel w_L = (2v - bw)/(2r).
Wheel radius r = 32.5 mm, wheelbase b = 216 mm; zero lateral skid condition.
slides.caption: Figure 5.12: Instantaneous Rotation Center (IRC) and robot coordinate frames

slides.title: System Identification & 3 Transfer Functions
bullets: Experimental 7V and 8V step inputs applied to DC motors and heading dynamics at 50 Hz.

slides.cap2: Figure 5.13: IMU heading step responses at 0.15 m/s and 0.30 m/s

slides.title: PI & PID Controller Tuning & Response Parameters
summary_bullets: Minimum effective PWM duty cycle of 15% is applied to the TB6612FNG driver to overcome static friction dead zone.
Routh-Hurwitz criterion and pole-zero constellation verify all motor and heading closed-loop poles lie strictly in the open LHP (Asymptotically Stable).

slides.title: Supervisory Finite-State Machine (FSM)
bullets: States: INIT, RANDOM_WALK, WALL_FOLLOW, SPIRAL_CLEAN, OBSTACLE_AVOID, STUCK_RECOVERY.
Cliff drop danger and bumper collision take absolute override priority over routine cleaning.
ESP32 supervises state transitions and dispatches target (v, w) commands to STM32 at 50 Hz.
Deterministic arbitration guarantees smooth transition and recovery from confined trap zones.
slides.caption: Figure 1.16: General operating process and state arbitration flow

slides.title: Reactive Cleaning Behaviors & Autonomous Recovery
bullets: Generates expanding trajectory r(theta) = a + b*theta for intensive spot debris pickup.
Maintains constant lateral distance along room perimeter using side infrared sensors.
Instantaneous 50 mm reverse followed by randomized rotation (90 deg - 150 deg).
Detects encoder stall; executes alternating push-pull pulses and 360 deg spins.
slides.cap1: Figure 6.3: Archimedean spiral cleaning trajectory algorithm
slides.cap2: Figure 6.5: Reactive obstacle avoidance and disengagement routine

slides.title: Physical Prototype & Hardware Fabrication
bullets: FDM 3D printed ABS chassis structure with 0.2 mm layer height and structural infill.
Coaxial differential drive motors, cantilever roller brush, dual side sweepers, dustbin.
Measured total mass 3.85 kg <= 4.0 kg specification requirement.
Measured overall height 81.5 mm <= 82 mm (navigates under 110 mm furniture clearance).
slides.cap1: Figure 7.1: Fully assembled operational robot vacuum prototype
slides.cap2: Figure 7.2: Fabricated cantilever main roller brush and timing belt drive

slides.title: Motion Performance & Trajectory Tracking Tests
bullets: Closed-loop heading PID achieves straight tracking with deviation < 18 mm (open-loop > 120 mm).
90 deg and 180 deg in-place spin tests verify steady-state orientation error < 2.5 deg (|ess| <= 5 deg).
Motor speed achieves settling time Ts = 0.14 s without oscillation under loaded floor conditions.
Differential drive speed synchronization maintained across wood and ceramic tile surfaces.

slides.title: Floor Cleaning Coverage & Debris Retrieval Tests
bullets: Achieved 95.24% floor coverage in 60 m2 open workspace within 10 mins (>= 70% target).
Achieved 85.55% coverage in furnished room with tables, chairs, and corners.
Recorded 95.22% retrieval for paper scraps and 75.33% retrieval for dry sand.
Battery voltage decreased only 0.16V (15.70V to 15.54V) after 10-min test run; uptime exceeds 75 mins.
slides.cap1: Figure 7.14: 10-Minute floor cleaning coverage trajectory (95.24% achieved)
slides.cap2: Figure 7.17: Paper scraps particulate debris retrieval verification test

slides.title: Research Achievements & Future Roadmap
bullets: Successfully researched, designed, fabricated, and validated an autonomous indoor robot vacuum.
Met all mechanical specifications (H = 81.5 mm, m = 3.85 kg) and cleaning coverage (> 85%).
Demonstrated fast motor speed regulation (Ts = 0.14 s) and heading yaw drift mitigation (< 18 mm).
Equip 2D LiDAR for SLAM global mapping, active obstacle classification, and auto-charging dock.
